title: Halt memo on Rendlesham lights

tellings.quote: Lieutenant Colonel Charles halt detailed the entire incident in a memo to the UK Ministry of Defense he said that a security patrol saw strange lights descending into the nearby rendlesham Forest

plain: In 1980, at RAF Bentwaters, an air base in England, a security patrol is said to have seen strange lights coming down into nearby Rendlesham Forest, and Lieutenant Colonel Charles Halt wrote the whole incident up in a memo to the UK Ministry of Defence. Michels tells this himself, while setting up an episode with Robert Hastings, a researcher of UFOs seen near nuclear bases. He gives no wording from the memo, only that it described the patrol's sighting. If it holds, it would be a senior officer putting a UFO sighting at a military base on paper.
